title: Nonclaim reclassification ledger for capability-first admission
notes: This ledger seeds classification for the historical explicitlyNotClaimed list.
Classes marked provisional_heuristic require review before unfreeze.
Unfreeze requires zero unclassified and zero unresolved blocking_capability_gap.
Exact residual expansion is not the default closure path for pdfjs_implementation_non_goal items.

taxonomy.blocking_capability_gap: Real missing/weak capability that can fail agent tasks or block sole-runtime publish.
taxonomy.quality_risk: May affect answer quality; needs task-eval corpus evidence rather than exact JSON equality.
taxonomy.compatibility_only: Compatibility/packaging/docs/marketing concern not itself a document-intelligence semantic contract.
taxonomy.pdfjs_implementation_non_goal: PDF.js implementation quirk or residual-outside representation breadth; stop exact chasing.
taxonomy.equivalent_representation: Different representation that can still support the same task when documented.
taxonomy.security_or_resource_bound: Security, hostile-input, or resource-bound fail-closed requirement; keep executable.
taxonomy.unclassified: Temporary; must be reclassified before unfreeze.
